en: Black‑and‑white view of a wide cobblestone square in a historic European town, centered on a Baroque/Renaissance-style town building with a small tower and clock. The facade bears the inscription "KOENIGLICHES AMTSGERICHT" (Royal District Court). Large pruned trees stand in front of the building, and a lamppost is visible. Surrounding the square are traditional gabled houses with shops on the ground floor. A few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk in the square. Church spires rise in the distance on the left.
